pages.title: 今天你感觉怎么样

text.en:
Everyone in the world has feelings.

We all have different feelings all day long.

Sometimes we feel peaceful, quiet and calm.

Sometimes we feel upset, cross or restless.

How do you feel today?
text.zh:
世界上的每个人都有情绪。

一天当中，我们都会有各种不同的感受。

有时，我们感觉安宁、安静又平和。

有时，我们会难过、生气，或者坐立不安。

你今天感觉怎么样？

pages.title: 睡前还很兴奋

text.en:
At Mia and Jackson's house, it's time for bed.

But they feel bouncy and excited!

They are tired but they can't calm down.

How do other people around the world find their calm?
text.zh:
在米娅和杰克逊家里，到了睡觉的时间。

可他们还是活蹦乱跳，特别兴奋！

他们已经累了，却没法让自己平静下来。

世界上其他人是怎样找到平静的呢？

pages.title: 生日会上的雨果

text.en:
Hugo is having a birthday party.

He is feeling very excited.

It's usually fun to feel happy and excited.

But today it is getting too much for Hugo to control.

Hugo feels hot and shaky.

He can't wait for his gifts.

He snatches the presents from his friends' hands.

The other children don't like it.

He doesn't like the feeling either.
text.zh:
雨果正在举办生日会。

他感到特别兴奋。

感到开心和兴奋，通常是很快乐的事。

可今天的雨果太兴奋了，都快控制不住自己了。

雨果觉得身体发热，直发抖。

他迫不及待地想要礼物。

他一把抢过朋友们手里的礼物。

其他小朋友不喜欢他这样做。

他自己也不喜欢这种感觉。

pages.title: 慢慢数到十

text.en:
Hugo's mum helps him to find his calm.

They go to a quiet corner.

Hugo counts to ten on his fingers, very quietly.

He does it again, this time even more slowly.

It worked!

Hugo feels calmer.

He's not hot and shaky anymore.

He feels excited, but not too much.

Now he and his friends can all enjoy his party.
text.zh:
雨果的妈妈帮他找回平静。

他们来到一个安静的角落。

雨果用手指轻轻地数到十。

他又数了一遍，这次数得更慢了。

这个办法有用！

雨果感觉平静多了。

他不再觉得身体发热，也不再发抖了。

他还是很兴奋，但已经不会兴奋过头了。

现在，他和朋友们都能尽情享受生日会了。

pages.title: 闹市里看蝴蝶

text.en:
This is not a calm place.

It's noisy and busy.

Cars are honking.

Lights are flashing.

There are lots of people rushing about and talking loudly.

So, how come Harper feels so calm?

She is looking carefully at a brightly coloured butterfly.

She watches its wings gently open and close.

She's forgotten about all the hustle and bustle around her!
text.zh:
这可不是一个宁静的地方。

这里又吵又忙。

汽车的喇叭响个不停。

灯光不停地闪烁。

许多人匆匆忙忙地走来走去，大声说话。

那么，为什么哈珀还能这么平静呢？

她正在仔细地看着一只色彩鲜艳的蝴蝶。

她看着蝴蝶的翅膀轻轻地张开、合上。

她已经忘了周围所有的喧闹和忙乱！

pages.title: 滑梯顶上的害怕

text.en:
This park is quiet, but Ryan doesn't feel calm.

He really wants to try the slide, but when he gets to the top of the ladder he feels scared.

The scared feeling makes Ryan's heart race.

It makes him breathe very quickly.

What can he do to find calm?
text.zh:
公园里很安静，可瑞安并不平静。

他很想试一试滑梯，可爬到梯子顶端时，他害怕了。

害怕让瑞安的心怦怦直跳。

也让他呼吸得特别急促。

他能做些什么，让自己平静下来呢？

pages.title: 像闻花一样深呼吸

text.en:
Ryan picks some dandelions.

He breathes in through his nose to smell the flowers.

He holds his breath for a few seconds ...

Then he breathes out and blows the seeds away into the air.

Breathing in and out slowly helps people feel calm.

Ryan takes another deep breath and climbs the ladder.

Wheeeee - down the slide he goes!
text.zh:
瑞安摘了几朵蒲公英。

他用鼻子吸气，闻闻花香。

他屏住呼吸，停了几秒……

接着，他呼出气来，把种子吹向空中。

慢慢地吸气、呼气，能帮助人们平静下来。

瑞安又深吸了一口气，爬上梯子。

哇——他顺着滑梯滑下来了！

pages.title: 一个温暖的拥抱

text.en:
It's hard to feel calm when we get bumped or cut, bruised or stung.

It hurts and it can feel scary too.

Our brain is telling us to be scared and our body is telling us we're in pain.

Hugs can help.

Karina just fell off her sledge, but a big, long hug with Mum is helping her to feel calm.

As she cries and hugs, she notices the pain is going away.
text.zh:
当我们撞伤、划伤、碰青或被蜇时，很难保持平静。

那会很疼，也可能让人害怕。

大脑让我们感到害怕，身体则在提醒我们正在疼痛。

拥抱能帮上忙。

卡丽娜刚从雪橇上摔了下来，但妈妈一个长长的大拥抱正让她慢慢平静下来。

她一边哭，一边拥抱妈妈，渐渐发现没那么疼了。

pages.title: 用画画表达感受

text.en:
Akiki feels upset, but he doesn't know why.

He just does.

He picks up some chalk and starts to draw.

He doodles and makes shapes without thinking about what he is drawing.

Scribbling and drawing can let your feelings out.

Akiki feels calmer by doing lots of big, wild scribbles.

You could try this too.
text.zh:
阿基基很难过，但他不知道为什么。

他就是觉得不开心。

他拿起粉笔，开始画画。

他随手涂涂画画，画出各种形状，不去想自己画的是什么。

涂鸦和画画能让你把情绪释放出来。

阿基基大大地、自由地涂画了一番，感觉平静多了。

你也可以试一试。

pages.title: 丢掉气球以后

text.en:
What happened here?

Oh no!

Li Wei has lost his balloon.

It's floating away, high in the sky.

He is so upset.

He is hot and bothered, sad and cross.

Have you ever felt like this?

Now, Li Wei has found a way to be calm again.

He is staying very still and watching the clouds go by.

He is looking very closely to see what shapes he can spot among the clouds!
text.zh:
这里发生了什么？

哦，不！

李伟的气球飞走了。

气球越飘越远，飞向高高的天空。

他特别难过。

他觉得又热又烦，既伤心又生气。

你有没有过这样的感受？

现在，李伟找到了重新平静下来的办法。

他静静地待着，看着云朵飘过。

他仔细观察，看看能从云朵里发现哪些形状！

pages.title: 生气时不伤害别人

text.en:
It's okay to feel angry sometimes.

Everyone does.

But it's not okay to lose your temper and push or hurt others.

After Maryam's anger bursts out, she gets into trouble.

She says sorry, but her body still feels hot and stiff and her fists are clenched tight.
text.zh:
有时感到生气，没关系。

每个人都会生气。

但是，不可以乱发脾气，推搡或伤害别人。

玛丽娅姆大发脾气后，惹了麻烦。

她道了歉，可身体还是发热、紧绷，拳头也握得紧紧的。

pages.title: 听听柔和的声音

text.en:
Maryam stomps off.

She feels like sulking.

But, in a corner of the garden she finds her grandfather.

He is playing his flute.

She sits in the cool shade and listens.

The music is soft and dreamy.

Slowly, Maryam relaxes.

She hums along with the tune.

Listening to soothing music or gentle sounds is a great way to find your calm.
text.zh:
玛丽娅姆跺着脚走开了。

她想一个人闷闷地生气。

不过，在花园的一角，她看见了爷爷。

他正在吹笛子。

她坐在凉爽的树荫下，静静地听着。

音乐轻柔，如梦一般。

慢慢地，玛丽娅姆放松下来了。

她跟着曲调轻轻哼唱。

听舒缓的音乐或轻柔的声音，是找回平静的好办法。

pages.title: 伸展身体，重新开始

text.en:
Ava usually feels calm when she plays with her bricks.

But today it's all gone wrong.

She spent a long time making that castle.

Now it's broken.

Ava has an idea.

She finds a space to stretch.

She reaches her arms up high.

She moves slowly and concentrates hard on balancing.

Soon she will feel calm and she'll be ready to make a new castle.
text.zh:
艾娃玩积木时，通常会感到很平静。

可今天，一切都不顺利。

她花了很长时间才搭好那座城堡。

现在，它却倒了。

艾娃有了一个主意。

她找了个地方伸展身体。

她把双臂高高举起。

她慢慢地移动，专心保持平衡。

不久，她就会平静下来，准备好再搭一座新城堡。

pages.title: 在故事里安心入睡

text.en:
Back at Mia and Jackson's house, it's all calm now ...

What's happened?

They are listening to a story.

Mia is cuddling her favourite toy and Jackson is stroking their cat.

They'll soon be fast asleep ...
text.zh:
再回到米娅和杰克逊家里，现在一切都平静下来了……

发生了什么呢？

他们正在听故事。

米娅抱着最喜欢的玩具，杰克逊正轻轻抚摸他们的小猫。

他们很快就会甜甜地睡着了……

sentences.spokenText: What's happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么呢？

sentences.text: They are listening to a story.
sentences.spokenText: They are listening to a story.
sentences.zh: 他们正在听故事。

contents.en: Back at Mia and Jackson's house, it's all calm now ...
contents.zh: 米娅抱着玩具，杰克逊抚摸小猫，听故事后安静地睡去。

pages.narrationText: Back at Mia and Jackson's house, it's all calm now ... What's happened? They are listening to a story. Mia is cuddling her favourite toy and Jackson is stroking their cat. They'll soon be fast asleep ...

text.en:
Which activity will you use to calm down when you feel upset or cross?

Count to ten on your fingers, quietly and slowly.

Focus all your attention on watching an object closely.

Breathe in and out very slowly and think about what you're doing.

Have a big hug with someone you love.

Scribble, draw or do some colouring.

Look for animals in the clouds.

Listen to soothing music or gentle sounds.

Stretch and balance to help your whole body relax.

Read or listen to a story in a quiet place.
text.zh:
当你难过或生气时，你会用哪种活动让自己平静下来？

用手指轻轻地、慢慢地数到十。

集中注意力，仔细观察一样东西。

慢慢地吸气、呼气，留意自己正在做的动作。

给你爱的人一个大大的拥抱。

涂鸦、画画，或者涂涂颜色。

看看云朵里藏着哪些小动物。

听舒缓的音乐或轻柔的声音。

伸展身体、练习平衡，帮助全身放松。

在安静的地方读故事，或者听故事。
